title: Keyport Historical Society

services.name: Whaleboat Race
services.desc: As part of the nationwide celebration of America's 250th Anniversary, the Keyport Historical Society is proud to partner with the Matawan Aberdeen Historical Society, the Borough of Keyport, the Borough of Matawan, and Aberdeen Township to present the inaugural Great Whaleboat Races. Inspired by Capt. William Marriner's daring 1778 whaleboat raid, this exciting community event transforms an extraordinary chapter of local history into a fun-filled day of competition and celebration. Teams representing Keyport, Matawan, and Aberdeen will race traditional-style whaleboats across Lake Lefferts on a mission worthy of the Revolutionary era.
